CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red set) is paired with explicit origin/representation metadata for the same referent/time, and identity and status are separately recorded.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to a content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content (positions) labeled under red for a current representation.

D.rationale: Content identity (red positions) is recorded separately from status/metadata (origin/represented_time) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report records how the content is presented/represented (origin kind and represented_time) for the current referent.
